title: WeekScheduleOverride
description: Per-ISO-week schedule override. Created when the user drags workouts to different days, or when the rules engine reschedules within the week. Does not modify long-term default training days.

trainingDays.description: Days the user is available to train this week. May differ from preferences.preferredTrainingDays.

unavailableDays.description: Days the user has marked unavailable for any training (e.g. travel, work).

workoutDateMap.description: Mapping of workoutId to its overridden scheduledDate within this ISO week.

guardrailWarnings.description: Non-blocking warnings produced by the rules engine when validating the override.
